spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Koh Tam casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}):

action.name: Arbiter's Touch
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) radiant damage.

action.name: Judgement
entries: Koh Tam judges a creature within 60 feet of him. The target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or take 50 ({@damage 10d8 + 5}) radiant damage. If the target had fewer hit points than their maximum prior to this attack, the creature takes 70 ({@damage 10d12 + 5}) radiant damage instead.

action.name: Arbiter's Light {@recharge 4}
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 9} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}70 ({@damage 10d12 + 5}) radiant damage, and the target has the {@condition blinded} condition until the start of Koh Tam's next turn.
